title: Nepal Increases Cost of Permits to Climb Everest
titleZh: 尼泊尔提高攀登珠穆朗玛峰的许可证费用
credits: Andrew Smith adapted this story for VOA Learning English based on reporting from Agence France-Presse.

sentences.en: The government of Nepal has increased the cost of a permit to climb Mount Everest by about one-third.
sentences.zh: 尼泊尔政府将攀登珠穆朗玛峰的许可证费用提高了约三分之一。

sentences.en: Officials say the price increase aims to help reduce pollution and increase safety on the world’s highest mountain.
sentences.zh: 官员表示，提高价格旨在帮助减少污染并提高世界最高峰的安全性。

sentences.en: The director of Nepal’s tourism department is Narayan Prasad Regmi.
sentences.zh: 尼泊尔旅游局局长是纳拉扬·普拉萨德·雷格米。

sentences.en: He told the French news agency AFP the cost for a permit in the popular spring climbing season will increase from $11,000 to $15,000.
sentences.zh: 他向法国法新社表示，在热门的春季攀登季，许可证费用将从1.1万美元提高到1.5万美元。

sentences.en: Regmi noted the price had remained the same for about 10 years, so the government decided it was time to make a change.
sentences.zh: 雷格米指出，这一价格约10年来保持不变，因此政府决定是时候做出改变了。

sentences.en: The costs, or fees, for climbing during less popular and more difficult times of year -- such as during winter or the summer monsoon rains -- have also increased.
sentences.zh: 在一年中人气较低、难度较大的时段——如冬季或夏季季风雨季——攀登的费用也有所提高。

sentences.en: This includes an increase from $5,500 to $7,500 during the autumn climbing season.
sentences.zh: 其中包括秋季攀登季从5500美元提高到7500美元。

sentences.en: Thousands of climbers come to Nepal each year.
sentences.zh: 每年有数千名登山者来到尼泊尔。

sentences.en: The country is home to eight of 14 of the world’s tallest mountains over 8,000 meters.
sentences.zh: 这个国家拥有全球14座海拔超过8000米高峰中的8座。

sentences.en: Everest is 8,849-meters tall and sits on the border between Nepal and China.
sentences.zh: 珠穆朗玛峰海拔8849米，位于尼泊尔与中国边界之上。

sentences.en: Foreign climbers spend tens of thousands of dollars on their efforts to climb Everest.
sentences.zh: 外国登山者花费数万美元用于攀登珠穆朗玛峰的尝试。

sentences.en: More than 400 people bought climbing permits for Everest last year.
sentences.zh: 去年有超过400人购买了攀登珠穆朗玛峰的许可。

sentences.en: This brought in around $4 million to the government.
sentences.zh: 这为政府带来了约400万美元的收入。

sentences.en: Nepal uses the money to remove waste from the mountain and to finance search and rescue operations.
sentences.zh: 尼泊尔用这笔钱清除山上的垃圾，并为搜救行动提供资金。

sentences.en: Some mountain climbing companies worry the higher price could lower the number of climbers wanting to climb Everest from the Nepalese side.
sentences.zh: 一些登山公司担心更高的价格可能会降低从尼泊尔一侧攀登珠穆朗玛峰的登山者人数。

sentences.en: The companies warn that some climbers might decide to climb Everest through China.
sentences.zh: 公司警告说，一些登山者可能决定通过中国攀登珠穆朗玛峰。

sentences.en: "Some climbers might shift to Tibet where the facilities are much better," said Mingma G Sherpa.
sentences.zh: 夏尔巴向导明玛格勒说：'一些登山者可能转向西藏，那里的设施要好得多。'

sentences.en: He runs the Imagine Nepal mountaineering company and says Nepal must use the money to improve conditions.
sentences.zh: 他经营着'想象尼泊尔'登山公司，并表示尼泊尔必须利用这笔资金来改善条件。

sentences.en: "Our government just increases the royalty, but doesn't do much.
sentences.zh: "我国政府只是提高特许权使用费，却没有采取太多措施。"

sentences.en: It needs to also provide support to the climbers and guides," he added.
sentences.zh: 他补充说，它还需要为登山者和向导提供支持。

sentences.en: Some groups have criticized Nepal for permitting too many climbers on Everest while not doing enough to keep the mountain clean.
sentences.zh: 一些团体批评尼泊尔在珠穆朗玛峰上允许过多的登山者，却没有采取足够措施保持山峰清洁。

sentences.en: Last year, Nepal’s government ordered all Everest climbers to carry trackers and bags to remove their human waste.
sentences.zh: 去年，尼泊尔政府要求所有珠穆朗玛峰登山者携带定位器和袋子以清理人体排泄物。

sentences.en: The government approved the fee increase in January, but it was first published on February 3.
sentences.zh: 政府于一月批准了费用上调，但直到2月3日才首次公布。

sentences.en: I’m Andrew Smith.
sentences.zh: 我是安德鲁·史密斯。
